01 / My perspective

The whole journey
shapes the experience.

I came to design from the side that pays for the traffic. Working across automotive, insurance, and local services taught me to look closely at what happens between a click and a meaningful result.

At Life Storage, that meant acquisition across 14 markets and a roughly $150K monthly budget. At Force Marketing, it meant managing campaigns for dealerships. At Melon Local, it means paid search, Performance Max, and practical AI workflows for lead generation.

That background shapes the questions I ask: Where do people hesitate? What information helps them decide? How do we measure whether the experience actually works?
